```freelang
// HTTP/2 최적화
fn optimize_http2(request: Request) -> Response {
  // 멀티플렉싱
  stream_id = allocate_stream()
  
  // 헤더 압축 (HPACK)
  headers = compress_headers(request.headers)
  
  // 우선순위 설정
  set_priority(stream_id, request.priority)
  
  return send_response(headers)
}

// REST 라우터
fn match_route(path: string, method: string) -> Handler {
  match method {
    "GET" => handle_get(path),
    "POST" => handle_post(path),
    "PUT" => handle_put(path),
    "DELETE" => handle_delete(path),
    _ => error("Unknown method")
  }
}
```

- R1: HTTP/2 처리량 >50K req/sec
- R2: P99 지연 <100ms
- R3: 메모리 <500MB

- R5: Serialization <5ms
- R6: CORS 검증 100%

- R8: 백프레셔 동작 100%
- R9: 재연결 <5sec
- R10: Keep-Alive 효율 >95%

- Day 3-4: http2_optimizer + connection_pool (1,000줄)
